content.passage: This is Angela Higgins with your weekly weather forecast. We are expecting a quick shower on Tuesday, but you will be getting plenty of sunshine throughout the rest of the week. His latest release has sold millions of copies all around the world, including America, Europe, and Asia. Without further ado, let's welcome him with a big round of applause.
